body.name: \(\widehat{\mathfrak F}_n\)
body.construction: Set \(\widehat p_{n,j}=n^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^n\mathbf 1\{X_{ni}=j\}\) and \(\widehat u_n=\sqrt n\,\widehat\Delta_n\). For \(c=t/(1-t)\) and \(0<t<1\), define \(\widehat{\mathfrak F}_n(t)=(1+c)\sum_{j\in\mathcal J}\widehat p_{n,j}[\Psi_{c,b_j}(R\widehat u_{n,j})-b_j^{\top}R\widehat u_{n,j}]\). Define \(\widehat{\mathfrak F}_n(0)=\sum_{j\in\mathcal J}\widehat p_{n,j}[\max_{a\in\mathcal A}(R\widehat u_{n,j})_a-b_j^{\top}R\widehat u_{n,j}]\) and \(\widehat{\mathfrak F}_n(1)=\frac12\sum_{j\in\mathcal J}\widehat p_{n,j}\widehat u_{n,j}^{\top}R^{\top}C(b_j)R\widehat u_{n,j}\).
